The '''N-s6 fire-control module''' was a model of [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]]. It was used on the [[TIE crawler/Legends|Century tank]] for weapons targeting, and featured many of the same controls and interfaces that were used aboard [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]].<ref name="EGVV" />
